title: v0.8.5 - Spreadsheet Collaboration
description: This release introduces full real-time collaboration for spreadsheets, complete with presence indicators, edit synchronization, and an enhanced sharing system for teams.

items.title: Real-time Collaboration
items.description: Socket-based collaboration system allowing multiple users to work on the same spreadsheet simultaneously.
details: Presence Tracking: Colored cursors and name tags show exactly where other collaborators are working.
Live Edit Sync: Edits are instantly broadcasted to all collaborators as they happen.
Room Management: Automatic joining and leaving of spreadsheet 'rooms' based on tab activity.
Live Mode Toggle: Opt-in for real-time collaboration with a single click in the toolbar.

items.title: Unified Sharing System
items.description: A completely refactored sharing system that works consistently across dashboards and spreadsheets.
details: Context-Sensitive Access: Define 'Collaboration' or 'View Only' levels for spreadsheet invites.
Public Sharing: Dashboards retain the ability to generate public view links.
Centralized Management: Revoke access or update permissions from a single generic Share Dialog.

items.title: Engine & Eventing Overhaul
items.description: Upgraded the spreadsheet engine to support robust real-time synchronization.
details: Source Tracking: Distinguishes between local and remote edits to prevent synchronization loops.
Unified Broadcasting: All local changes (paste, delete, AI tools) are now correctly broadcasted.
Optimized Presence Render: Presence indicators are now more reactive and sync directly with the engine's internal state map.

items.title: In-Depth Analysis UI
details: Markdown Rendering: Analysis reports now use rich formatting, including bold text, bullet points, and headers.
Improved Spacing: Better vertical rhythm and padding for longer reports.
Action Bar Refined: Reorganized buttons in the report footer for faster navigation.

items.title: Database Provider Resolution
items.description: Resolved a critical issue where certain database providers were not correctly identified in chat sessions.
details: Added fallback logic to derive providers from connection configuration keys.
